turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good morning, welcome to Hartley Car Hire. Come in out of the drizzle. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Morning! Thanks, it's properly chucking it down out there. I'm only here for a few weeks, so I'd like to hire something for a trip.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Lovely. Is this your first visit to the city?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It is, actually. I flew in on Saturday from Toronto and I've mostly been wandering round the cathedral and the market. Everyone's been really friendly, though the buses confuse me a bit.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Oh, the buses confuse all of us, don't worry. Right, let's get you booked in. I'll start with your birthday, so the system can check you're old enough to drive one of ours.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ha, I'm old enough, I promise. It's 23 September, so it's coming up soon, and my friends are already plotting something.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Brilliant, I'll make a note to say happy birthday in advance. And where are you staying while you're here? I need an address for the paperwork, I'm afraid. It's a bit of a boring part of the job.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Um, well, it's a little rented flat near the river that my cousin found for me. The door says 58, up on the first floor.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Lovely, near the river, that's handy for the bus station too. And what's the road called? Sorry, I always get local names wrong, so would you mind spelling it for me? I'd rather not send anything to the wrong place.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Of course. It's Cressbrook Road, that's C-R-E-S-S-B-R-O-O-K, then Road. Everyone gets that wrong, even the postman.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Got it, thanks. And which part of the area is that? Sorry to keep asking, but the map on my screen isn't showing it, and it's been playing up all week.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Oh, it's a village just outside, a twenty-minute walk from the river. It's called Whitcombe, W-H-I-T-C-O-M-B-E, and it has one pub and a very loud church clock.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ha, I know the sort. Right, now I need to look at your licence, please. Oh, the print on this one is really faint. Is the reference 27106?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No, it's 27160. The last two digits are the other way round, I know, it confuses everyone, including the people who issued it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That's it, thank you. Now, what are you planning with the hire? Where are you headed, or are you just going to wander about and see what happens?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Well, we've got a proper plan, actually. Down to the coast, to Aldeburgh, A-L-D-E-B-U-R-G-H. I've heard the fish and chips there are unbelievable.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Lovely spot, we get lots of people going there. What sort of vehicle would suit you? We've got small hatchbacks, estates, all sorts out the back.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Well, there'll be six of us with luggage, because my cousin's family are coming too, so a people carrier, the sort with sliding doors. Not a hatchback or an estate, we'd never fit.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Fair enough, we've got a couple of those on the forecourt. When would you like to collect it?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Um, I'll collect it on Tuesday, no, sorry, Thursday, I keep getting muddled. My cousin lands late the night before, so I'll go for a lazy morning.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Thursday it is. And how long are you thinking? Some people keep ours for 40 days, you know, the whole winter.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Ha, I wish. Just 14 for us, the two weeks my cousin's off work. We'll be glad to get home after that, honestly.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Sounds perfect. Last thing, and it's the boring bit. How much protection would you like on it? The basic one leaves you paying the first five hundred pounds if you scratch it.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Well, I'm a nervous driver on narrow lanes, and I'll be on the wrong side of the road, so I'd rather have full cover, everything included.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Very wise. Right, if you pop your signature here and leave a deposit on your card, I'll bring the keys round and show you where everything is.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Wonderful, thank you so much. You've been really helpful, and I'll try not to bring it back with a scratch.
